description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger You take damage of a type you have already taken this encounter.

You gain resistance 5 to that damage type until the end of the encounter, or resistance equal to half your level if that is higher. You can only be resistant to one damage type at a time this way; taking it for a new type ends the old one.

cinderfall.incomplete: Taking a repeated damage type grants resistance 5 (or half level) to that type until the encounter ends, replacing any prior instance. The resisted type is chosen dynamically at trigger time and must persist/override -- Resistance's own type field is fixed at authoring time, and no rule element records a dynamically-selected value at trigger-time the way a ChoiceSet records a feat-selection-time choice.
